text:
monica: Heads up — thinking about adding a compact 'diff preview' for audit downloads in the Console. Goal: let reviewers scan what changed (keys + actor + context) without downloading giant JSONs. Thoughts?

alex: +1. Could be just the changed paths, actor, and a short reason. Good for quick triage.

jamal: We need routing & quota context included. If someone changed a routing policy, seeing the diff without the policy id/route match is useless.

tara: Agree on context. Also: PII/redaction. The compact diff should never leak redacted values. Instead, show redaction metadata (e.g., "redacted": true) and which fields were removed.

kevin: API question: do we emit diffs as separate "delta" events at write-time, or compute diffs on export?

monica: Proposal: materialize a tiny diff at write-time and attach it to the change event. Export path can choose between full snapshots and compact diffs. Example NDJSON line for compact mode:

```
{"event_id":"evt_20240601_001","ts":"2024-06-01T12:02:33Z","actor":"jamal","scope":"tenant:acme","resource":"routing:route-42","diff":[{"path":"/match/path","before":"/v1/*","after":"/v2/*"},{"path":"/quota/limit","before":1000,"after":500}],"redaction":{"/secret/api_key":true}}
```

alex: Nice. Maybe add a short human_message field for the Console preview like "reduced rate on route /payments" so reviewers understand intent at a glance.

tara: For UI, show inline expandable rows: summary line (human_message + actor + ts) then expand to compact diff list. Provide a link to download full snapshot if auditors need it.

jamal: Performance note: computing diffs for long time ranges on demand will blow CPU. We should precompute diffs as part of the change commit pipeline (we already have old+new object for policy writes). Store compact_diffs in the event store and index necessary fields for search.

kevin: Compliance asked for original values for legal holds. So full snapshots must be retained for flagged tenants. We can expose an export flag: `include_full_snapshots=true` but default compact. Need to record who requested full exports.

monica: API draft: `GET /api/v1/audit/exports?format=compact&since=...&tenant=...&redaction=masked` Where `format=compact|full|delta_stream`. Add `include_context=true` to include routing/quota context.

alex: Also add `preview=true` that returns first N compact items inline in Console (fast) and provides a presigned URL for the long export.

tara: UX edge: when diff contains array/object changes, compact representation should show JSON path + short snippet, not full embedded object. Example: `items[3].match -> ...`

jamal: Implementation plan summary I propose: 1) Add compact_diff generation at commit time (small job), 2) store compact_diff on event, 3) index actor/tenant/resource/human_message, 4) expose `format=compact` in export API + `preview` for Console.

kevin: Security: compact diffs must respect redaction modes (tenant-level PII policy). Also ensure audit exports respect KMS keys and enterprise retention settings.

monica: Operational question: what retention policy for compact diffs vs full snapshots? My suggestion: compact_diffs keep full retention (default 1y), full_snapshots tiered by subscription (enterprise keeps longer).

deploy-bot: Export job 293 started for tenant acme (format=compact).

alex: Ok let's prototype the API + Console preview with limited tenant rollout (internal + 2 customers). Jamal will own the backend, Tara will do Console pieces, Kevin will handle compliance sign-off, I'll wire the API surface. Monica will coordinate docs and release notes. :thumbsup:

monica: Cool. Action items: jamal create design PR describing commit-time diff shape + storage; tara mock the preview UX; kevin confirm legal/retention for full snapshots. Will follow up Monday. :spiral_calendar:
